cases.original_question: List the CRs in a CR pack with their change summaries (pack contents).
cases.original_query: MATCH (pack:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(c:CR) WITH pack, c ORDER BY c.tdocNumber LIMIT 10 RETURN pack.crPackId AS crPackId, c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange AS summary

evidence.finding: Own original specific-pack design/validation and exact unbound global query specify different scopes. Exact global10 spans six packs; two genuine single-pack first10 choices are disjoint with sort and extent fixed.
evidence.counterauthority: The exact authored global query and runner remain a plausible intended operational scope; no branch is silently selected.
evidence.required_author_decision: Specify named single pack, any source-authentic single pack with alternative-valid-answer acceptance, or global mapping, then settle extent.
evidence.scope_limits: Finite captured23262paths/1220packs and three own workbook membership rows only; no full physical pack or summary certification, approval or incorporation.

cases.original_question: Which companies contributed most to resolutions under NR MIMO (Agenda 7.1)? Top 10.
cases.original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company), (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '7.1' RETURN c.companyName, count(DISTINCT a) AS contributionCount ORDER BY contributionCount DESC LIMIT 10

evidence.finding: Original report headings and meeting-qualified agenda identity give different numeric7.1 and NR MIMO technology scopes; frozen documentary counts show actual Top10 membership differences.
evidence.counterauthority: The exact authored numeric7.1 query remains a strong operational interpretation if its technology descriptor is explicitly corrected; actual7.10 contamination is zero.
evidence.scope_limits: Author choice among numeric-first corrected descriptor, meeting-qualified technology scope or explicit intersection. No diagnostic lexical classifier is replacement gold.
